issues.description: In the template, simulate_msd_one_round currently contains an early line initializing a Stim circuit with circ = stim.Circuit(n_shots) inside the function body prior to the NotImplementedError. The reference solution initializes the circuit with stim.Circuit() inside its implementation. Having a partially-present initialization in the template (and using a constructor argument) is inconsistent and could confuse students about the intended starting state of the stub or about Stim's constructor usage.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the pre-filled circ = stim.Circuit(n_shots) line from the template stub (or replace it with circ = stim.Circuit() if a starter circuit is desired). Keep the function body minimal (e.g., only docstring and raise NotImplementedError) so students are not misled by partially-present implementation details or an atypical constructor usage.
